name: Gorgany: the Popadia Ring
description: A loop over the stone fields of the Gorgany: Osmoloda, Grofa, Parenky, Popadia, Koretvyna and back. The track links the stops; those without verified coordinates are placed along it.

osmoloda.name: Osmoloda
osmoloda.text: A forest village at the heart of the Gorgany, start of the ring.

kin-hrofetskyi.name: Kin Hrofetskyi
kin-hrofetskyi.text: The 'Horse of Hrofa', the first lookout above the forest.

grofa.name: Grofa
grofa.text: On a clear day you can see Hoverla, 84 km away.

parenky.name: Parenky
parenky.text: A stony summit with a wide view of Petros and Popadia.

popadia.name: Popadia
popadia.text: Its stone fields, the 'gorgany', gave the mountains their name.

koretvyna.name: Koretvyna
koretvyna.text: The last summit before the long descent.

osmoloda-return.name: Back in Osmoloda
osmoloda-return.text: The ring closes where it began.

story.stone-fields: Above the dwarf pines the path crosses fields of grey stone that move underfoot.
story.dwarf-pine: The mountain pine grows waist-high here and hides the path.

facts.gorgan-word: 'Gorgan' is the local word for a scree field of sandstone blocks; the whole range is named after them.
facts.grofa-view: From Grofa you can see Hoverla and the Chornohora ridge, 84 km away.
facts.highest: The highest peak of the Gorgany is Velyka Syvulia, 1836 m, east of this ring.
